messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "this raises the risk of side effects"
set: ["this raises the risk of side effects", "starting dose and escalation schedule designed to reduce risk of gastrointestinal side effects", "using more than the recommended dose may increase the chance of corticosteroid-related side effects", "using the drug for longer than directed may increase the chance of corticosteroid-related side effects", "tell your doctor if you are fasting or vomiting, because this raises your risk of low blood sugar", "treatment options are available for side effects", "take with meals to reduce side effects", "discuss sexual side effects with your doctor", "use slow-release tablets to reduce gastric side effects", "talk with your doctor about this risk", "call doctor right away if serious side effects occur", "call your doctor for medical advice about side effects", "you may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088", "keep this and all medicines out of the reach of children", "this is the reason for the recommendation", "registry is used to track the effects of methylphenidate on the baby"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
